Out-of-sample evidence

Research & Validation

Published test reports for the AQMath Deleverage Modulator. Each report is generated verbatim from the source write-up in the engine repository, so the figures here are the figures the test produced. The point of publishing them is that a drawdown claim is only worth as much as the test behind it.

  • Three-Basket Comparison — v14 KKT MACRO + Shield2026-08-05

    Walk-forward E2E comparison of three structurally different baskets (majors+gold, veterans+gold, new-gen alts) on the shipped v14 stack: shared-window max drawdown 9.8% vs 25.4% Buy & Hold; the Shield cut drawdown 30-36 pp in every window.

  • E2E Study — TIA / QNT / XRP + PAXG Anchor2026-08-03

    Walk-forward E2E test of a candidate basket (TIA, QNT, XRP, PAXG) on the live dual-speed stack: max drawdown 16.9% vs 24.6% Buy & Hold, beta 0.62; the KKT optimizer zero-weighted TIA on every re-optimisation.

  • OOS Validation — v14.0 on Unseen Tokens2026-07-17 · 中文

    Out-of-sample test of the shipped AQMath Deleverage Modulator v14.0 on 16 baskets of never-tuned tokens: median 54.3 pp drawdown cut, Calmar up in 16/16.
